A '''sandtrooper''' [[captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] served in a [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtrooper]] [[Unidentified sandtrooper regiment|regiment]] within the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Imperial Army]]. The trooper traveled to the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] to pursue the two rebel [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]], who were in posession of the [[Death Star plans]].

==Biography==
A sandtrooper [[captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] served in a [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtrooper]] [[Unidentified sandtrooper regiment|regiment]] within the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Imperial Army]]. During the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Secret mission to Tatooine|secret mission]] to the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Rise of the Rebellion" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> the two rebel [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] had the [[Death Star plans]] in their possession. [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] tasked [[Commander]] [[Praji]] of the [[501st Legion]] with his elite sandtrooper [[regiment]] to search [[Tatooine]] for the pair of droids and recover the plans.<ref name="Rise of the Rebellion" />

After discovering that the droids were in possession of the [[Lars family]] at the [[Lars homestead|Lars Homestead]], the captain led their [[trooper]]s to the settlement and had them search the home while the captain questioned [[Owen Lars]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars]]. It was then when the captain learned that Owen's nephew, [[Luke Skywalker]], left earlier that morning to lead the droids to their workstations. Suspecting that Skywalker was a rebel sympathizer, the captain sent a detachment to search for the nephew, although the captain suspected his forces would return empty-handed. After obtaining all of the relevant information, the captain and their troops returned to [[Mos Eisley]] while the few troopers left behind slaughtered the couple and burned down the homestead.<ref name="Rise of the Rebellion" />
